title: Opportunities and risks of artificial intelligence in patient portal messaging in primary care (npj Digital Medicine 2025;8)
authors_or_organization: Biro JM, Handley JL, Malcolm McCurry J, Visconti A, Weinfeld J, Trafton JG, Ratwani RM (MedStar Health National Center for Human Factors in Healthcare)
url: https://doi.org/10.1038/s41746-025-01586-2 (full text read via Europe PMC PMC12022076)
funding_or_commercial_relationships: AHRQ grant R03 HS030307 (per Europe PMC grant list); no vendor authorship identified
limitations: Cross-sectional simulation; 20 PCPs; 18 simulated messages, only 4 erroneous (errors identified post hoc by investigators, not deliberately engineered); single LLM (ChatGPT 4.0); no unassisted or traceability comparison arm; review time recorded only as total study time per participant; no patient chart context.

title: The effect of using a large language model to respond to patient messages (Lancet Digital Health 2024, correspondence; page numbers not recorded)
authors_or_organization: Chen S, Guevara M, Moningi S, Hoebers F, Elhalawani H, Kann BH, et al., Bitterman DS (Mass General Brigham / Dana-Farber)
url: https://doi.org/10.1016/S2589-7500(24)00060-8 (author manuscript read via Europe PMC PMC11829255)
limitations: Two-stage observational proof-of-concept; 6 radiation oncologists; 100 GPT-4-generated simulated cancer patient scenarios; stage order fixed (manual first, then LLM-assisted); efficiency was subjective (physician-reported), not timed; harm judged by the same assessing physicians; appendix not reviewed.

title: Evaluating Hospital Course Summarization by an Electronic Health Record-Based Large Language Model (JAMA Netw Open 2025;8(8):e2526339)
authors_or_organization: Small WR, Austrian J, O'Donnell L, Burk-Rafel J, Hochman KA, et al. (NYU Langone Health)
funding_or_commercial_relationships: not reviewed (EHR-embedded institutional LLM tool; health-system authors)
limitations: Quality-improvement study, convenience sample of 10 residents and 8 hospitalists, single site; artificial time limits (10 min record review, 3 min editing); confabulations rated comparatively on Likert scales after editing, not counted before/after; no CIs reported; no traceability/provenance manipulation. Read abstract plus WebFetch extraction of article page (first ~100k characters).

title: Advancing Toward Clinical Deployment of AI-Generated Discharge Summaries: Beyond the Bench (invited commentary, JAMA Netw Open 2025;8(8):e2526350)
limitations: Commentary on R3A-S03 (same evidence group); interpretive, no new data. Read via WebFetch extraction only.

title: The Impact of AI Assistance on Radiology Reporting: A Pilot Study Using Simulated AI Draft Reports (arXiv:2412.12042v1)
authors_or_organization: Acosta JN, Dogra S, Adithan S, Wu K, Moritz M, Kwak S, Rajpurkar P (Harvard Medical School and collaborators)
limitations: Pilot preprint (not peer reviewed); 3 readers (1 radiologist, 2 radiology residents); 20 chest CT cases; 59 signed reports; GPT-4-simulated drafts with 1-3 GPT-4-inserted errors in half the cases; underpowered for error outcomes; seeded-error catch rate not separately reported; one independent radiologist scored errors.

title: Efficiency and Quality of Generative AI-Assisted Radiograph Reporting (JAMA Netw Open 2025; e2513921)
authors_or_organization: Huang J, Wittbrodt MT, Teague CN, Karl E, Galal G, et al., Etemadi M (Northwestern Medicine)
funding_or_commercial_relationships: In-house model; secondary coverage (search snippets) reports author patents and early commercialization - not verified in the paper itself
limitations: Prospective nonrandomized cohort with matched baseline set (not RCT); peer review of 800 studies is a sample audit of final reports, not seeded-error detection; developer-authored; abstract only.

title: A Randomized Controlled Trial and Pilot of Scout: an LLM-Based EHR Search and Synthesis Platform (arXiv:2604.26953)
authors_or_organization: Gao M, Balu S, Knechtle W, ... Vemulapalli S (Duke Institute for Health Innovation / Duke Health)
funding_or_commercial_relationships: Developer-authored: the tool (Scout) was built by the authors' institution (Duke Health); funding/COI section not located in extracted text
limitations: Preprint; 20 participants (faculty physicians, trainees, APPs, others) across 7 use cases, 200 cases; comparator is EHR-only, so the effect of per-claim citations cannot be separated from LLM retrieval/synthesis; evaluator for each use case was the task author; no seeded errors; brief training.

title: Ambient AI Scribes in Clinical Practice: A Randomized Trial (NEJM AI 2025; doi:10.1056/AIoa2501000)
authors_or_organization: Lukac PJ, Turner W, Vangala S, Chin AT, Khalili J, Shih YT, Sarkisian C, Cheng EM, Mafi JN (UCLA)
url: https://doi.org/10.1056/AIoa2501000 (abstract read via Europe PMC, PMID 41497288)
funding_or_commercial_relationships: Funded by UCLA Department of Medicine and others (NIH grants listed); products are commercial (Microsoft DAX Copilot, Nabla); Nabla issued a press release on the results
limitations: Pragmatic RCT, single academic center, ~2 months; accuracy measured only by clinician self-report Likert items; no audit of whether clinicians caught scribe errors; abstract only.

title: A Pragmatic Randomized Controlled Trial of Ambient Artificial Intelligence to Improve Health Practitioner Well-Being (NEJM AI 2025;2(12); doi:10.1056/AIoa2500945)
authors_or_organization: Afshar M, Baumann MR, Resnik F, et al. (University of Wisconsin)
url: https://doi.org/10.1056/AIoa2500945 (abstract read via Europe PMC, PMC12858090)
funding_or_commercial_relationships: Funded by UW Hospital and Clinics and NIH CTSA; ambient AI product not named in abstract (secondary source says an Abridge product - not verified)
limitations: Stepped-wedge pragmatic trial, 66 practitioners; time on notes and quality are secondary outcomes; PDSQI-9 quality is an instrument rating, not seeded-error detection or omission audit against the encounter; abstract only.

title: Accuracy and Safety of AI-Enabled Scribe Technology: Instrument Validation Study (J Med Internet Res 2025;27:e64993)
authors_or_organization: Biro J, Handley JL, Cobb NK, Kottamasu V, Collins J, Krevat S, Ratwani RM (MedStar Health)
url: https://www.jmir.org/2025/1/e64993 (full text read via Europe PMC PMC11811668)
funding_or_commercial_relationships: not reviewed; two unnamed commercial ambient digital scribe products evaluated
limitations: Instrument validation (research letter); simulated encounters read by 2 researchers acting as patients; 44 draft notes; measures error prevalence, not clinician detection or review time.

title: Sentence-Level Provenance for AI Medical Record Summarization in a Click-to-Inspect Interface: Formative Usability Evaluation (JMIR Human Factors 2026;13:e95644)
limitations: Seen only via search-engine summary of the abstract/preprint pages; the PDF fetch returned empty content. Formative qualitative usability study with a convenience sample of clinicians; no quantitative time or detection outcome reported in what was seen.

title: Verify a Note With Linked Evidence (Abridge support article)
limitations: Direct fetch returned HTTP 403; content known only from search-result summary. Shows a deployed statement-to-transcript linking feature exists; contains no outcome data in what was seen. Vendor white paper on confabulation (Aug 2025) mentioned in search results was not retrieved.

title: FinGround: Detecting and Grounding Financial Hallucinations via Atomic Claim Verification (arXiv:2604.23588)
authors_or_organization: Guo D, Wu J, Yiu SM (The University of Hong Kong; Stellaris AI Limited)
funding_or_commercial_relationships: One author affiliated with Stellaris AI Limited (commercial); system developers ran the pilot
limitations: Primarily a technical benchmark paper; the analyst pilot is uncontrolled, single firm, 24 analysts, self-reported observations; authors call the results qualitative design signals, not population estimates; no comparison of citation granularity under controlled conditions.

title: AI-Generated Draft Replies Integrated Into Health Records and Physicians' Electronic Communication (JAMA Netw Open 2024; doi:10.1001/jamanetworkopen.2024.6565)
authors_or_organization: Tai-Seale M, Baxter SL, Vaida F, Walker A, Sitapati AM, et al. (UC San Diego Health)
funding_or_commercial_relationships: AHRQ P30 HS029770 (per Europe PMC); EHR-vendor-integrated GenAI drafting tool (vendor not named in abstract)
limitations: Randomized waiting-list QI study, 52 PCPs plus 70 contemporary controls; measures time and reply length, not reply accuracy or error detection; abstract only.
